name: wh_elec_kwh_per_sqft
unit: kWh per sq ft per yr
source_or_basis: CBECS 2018 C14 warehouse and storage median 3.4, mean 5.8 (checked in script against xlsx); high 12.6 = all-commercial mean, used in env_04 as a proxy for a conditioned automated building

name: wh_gas_kbtu_per_sqft
unit: kBtu per sq ft per yr
source_or_basis: 11.38 = CBECS 2018 C1 warehouse gas 199 TBtu / 17,483 million sq ft (checked in script); 0.5x and 2x range as in env_04 (ASSUMPTION)

name: retail_elec_kwh_per_sqft
unit: kWh per sq ft per yr
source_or_basis: CBECS 2018 C14 retail other than mall: median 9.0, mean 13.7; high 16.7 = all mercantile mean (includes malls)

name: retail_gas_kbtu_per_sqft
unit: kBtu per sq ft per yr
source_or_basis: 16.75 = retail other than mall 87 TBtu / 5,193 million sq ft; high 31.0 = mercantile 334 TBtu / 10,781 million sq ft; low = 0.5x central (ASSUMPTION)

name: gas_kg_co2e_per_kbtu
source_or_basis: EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025 Table 1 natural gas 53.06 kg CO2 per mmBtu (CH4 and N2O add about 0.1 percent, ignored)

name: walmart_dc_ratio_multiplier
source_or_basis: Walmart does not disclose DC square feet. Central = Target's own ratio of supply-chain-facility sq ft to store sq ft applied to Walmart US store sq ft; low/high multiply that ratio

name: amazon_usd_per_package
source_or_basis: Used only to turn Amazon GMV into a package count. Low-emission case has the HIGH value per package (fewer packages)

name: amazon_3p_gmv_share
unit: share of physical gross merchandise sales
source_or_basis: 58 percent in 2018 (Bezos 2018 shareholder letter, via CNBC 2019-04-11). Later figures (60 percent 2023, 61 percent of units Q4 2025) were seen only on secondary blogs. Held constant across years

name: substitution_realisation
unit: share of displaced store space whose energy is really avoided
source_or_basis: Closed stores sit vacant or are re-let; energy is only avoided if demolished or left unconditioned

name: nhts_oneway_trip_miles
source_or_basis: Table 3-5, shopping, 2022 = 5.8 miles, margin of error 0.4 (printed p.20 of FHWA-HPL-24-009); ONE survey year (2022) is used for length and counts. 2017 (7.0) is a separate sensitivity row

name: trip_legs_per_outing
source_or_basis: Used ONLY in the per-item basket table. An NHTS "person trip" is one leg (Appendix D: A to B and B to C are two trips), and shopping-purpose legs include the return leg (see interp_env_nhts_inputs.csv), so one store outing = 2 shopping legs. The national calibration in the attribution layer uses VMT directly and never multiplies by legs

name: trip_chaining_allocation
unit: share of outing charged to shopping
source_or_basis: Basket table only. Low = half of the outing belongs to other errands chained to it

name: car_kg_co2e_per_mile
source_or_basis: EPA GHG Hub 2025 Table 8: passenger car 0.297 kg CO2 + 5.9e-3 g CH4 + 5.3e-3 g N2O per mile; light-duty truck 0.394 + 1.09e-2 + 8.8e-3 (AR5 GWP 28 and 265); central = mean of car and light truck

name: van_kg_co2e_per_mile
unit: kg CO2e per vehicle-mile, loaded delivery van
status: LOW and HIGH sourced; central is an ASSUMPTION
source_or_basis: Low = FHWA average light truck/van 18.5 mpg (AFDC "Average Fuel Economy by Major Vehicle Category", citing FHWA Highway Statistics 2024 Table VM-1; the page prints categories and values separately, pairing inferred from ascending order) x 8.887 kg CO2 per gallon gasoline (EPA) = 0.48. High = FHWA delivery truck 7.19 mpg = 1.24 (box trucks, heavier than Amazon vans). Central 0.60 (14.8 mpg) = loaded stop-start cargo van, the adversarial review suggestion; not a published Amazon figure

name: delivery_miles_per_package
source_or_basis: Route miles / packages per route: 80/200, 100/150, 120/100. No public Amazon figure found

name: middle_mile_truck_miles_per_parcel_path
unit: truck miles from FC through sortation to delivery station
source_or_basis: Haul distance of the trailer each parcel rides

name: parcels_per_trailer
source_or_basis: Parcel trailers fill by volume before weight (review F4: about 3,000). Low-emission case has the HIGH number

name: truck_kg_co2e_per_vehicle_mile
source_or_basis: EPA GHG Hub 2025 Table 8 medium/heavy-duty truck vehicle-mile factor: 1.298 kg CO2 + 1.15e-2 g CH4 + 3.76e-2 g N2O = 1.308 (vehicle basis, not ton-mile, because parcel loads are volume-limited)

name: returns_rate_online
source_or_basis: Central case has NO returns. Rows with 0.15 and 0.30 appear in the sensitivity table; a return repeats outbound transport once. Store-side returns are not modelled. No public return-rate statistic was retrieved

name: air_share_of_packages
status: NOT MODELLED in central (flagged missing); 5% is a sensitivity assumption
source_or_basis: No public domestic air share found. Amazon 2025 report p.9 gives only a TRANSOCEANIC figure (3% of transoceanic shipments by air in 2025, down from 10% in 2024). The central own-emission figure therefore omits Amazon Air and is a floor

name: air_miles_per_package
source_or_basis: Only used if air share > 0

name: package_weight_lb
source_or_basis: Only used for air

name: air_kg_co2e_per_short_ton_mile
source_or_basis: EPA GHG Hub 2025 Table 8 aircraft: 1.086 kg CO2 + 3.34e-2 g N2O (x265)

name: trip_complement_offset
unit: share of avoided shopping VMT offset by new trips
status: ASSUMPTION (direction from Relihan 2022; Zhou and Wang 2014 SNIPPET ONLY)
source_or_basis: Avoided miles = sigma x shopping VMT per in-store dollar x (1 - offset). Column low = low-saving case
